messages:
alex: Heads-up  Greenwave Analytics returned an MSA with three redlines. They want (1) customer-managed KMS in the DPA, (2) start of POC conditional on PO receipt, and (3) VP-level signatory required on the order form. Need legal + finance input.

mira: Can you attach the PDF? We'll check exact wording. If they insist on customer KMS we need to confirm deployment choice (Private or Dedicated). Hosted won't fly.

alex: Uploaded: `Greenwave_MSA_redlines_2026.pdf` (link). Their KMS clause says "Customer shall provide and control all encryption keys used to protect Customer Data."

ben: From pricing: Dedicated estimate = hosted rate * 1.35. Private on-prem is quoted separately (SOW). Provisioning: Dedicated ~3-4 weeks after countersignature, Private ~4-8 weeks depending on network.

finance-bot: finance-bot: Net30 acceptable; EFT preferred. Require vendor setup (W-9) and invoice must include PO#. AP email: ap@greenwave.ai.

mira: Legal: We should push back on start date tied to PO. Proposed counter: "Services commence upon countersignature of the Order Form by both parties. Customer may issue a Purchase Order for accounting purposes which will not delay commencement." Thoughts?

tara: CS note: For POC we need an SLA-lite (uptime + single region) doc and a named technical contact. Also confirm whether telemetry / usage logs are OK to collect for debugging.

alex: They also asked for an explicit signature delegation clause naming the VP Finance. They said they won't allow other signers.

mira: We prefer generic "authorized signatory" language. If they insist on an individual, ask for a delegation letter on company letterhead.

ben: Operational: If they require customer KMS, we need KMS onboarding runbook and possibly a one-time engineering integration fee. I'll draft numbers for both scenarios (KMS + non-KMS).

finance-bot: finance-bot: Vendor onboarding checklist: W-9, remit-to, PO sample, billing contact. I'll DM alex the checklist.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Order Form template v2 uploaded to /drive/contracts/order-form-v2.pdf

alex: Plan: 1) Mira to draft counter MSA + suggested Order Form wording 2) Ben to post Dedicated vs Private cost + provisioning timeline 3) Finance-bot to send onboarding checklist and invoice template 4) Tara to prepare CS POC kickoff doc. I'll schedule a procurement sync with their AP for tomorrow 9am PT.

mira: I'll aim to drop the redline back within 6 hours.

ben: FYI if they demand HSM-backed KMS (BYOK with HSM), that pushes to Private and requires SRE/infra engagement early.

tara: Also confirm whether the POC will use sample data or production data. If prod data, we need tightened DPA terms.

alex: Thanks all  I'll post notes after the AP call. :thumbsup:
